column8: Freud’s revolutionary Quadra-Cut™ router bits redefine woodworking precision with innovative, patented technology that solves common routing challenges. Designed to deliver unparalleled results, these bits create flawless finishes on both hard and softwoods, eliminating the need for rework, sanding, or extra passes. Traditional router bits, limited to just two cutters, often leave behind splinters, fuzz, or tear-outs—especially on cross-grain cuts. This leads to time-consuming sanding and risks damaging your workpiece, ultimately compromising quality. Freud’s Quadra-Cut™ technology, an industry first, incorporates four precision-engineered cutting edges—double the standard. This patented design ensures a flawless finish on every pass, even on delicate materials. The first pair of cutting edges known as “Up-Shear Cutters” removes most of the material with an upward slicing motion, leaving a smooth bottom edge. While the second set of cutting edges, “Down-Shear Cutters,” follows with a downward slicing motion, perfecting the top edge and reducing tear-out to virtually zero. This dynamic pairing reduces vibration, improves energy efficiency, and ensures precise, professional results with minimal effort. Whether you’re crafting furniture, cabinetry, or intricate detailing, Freud’s Quadra-Cut™ router bits let you focus on creating, not correcting. For woodworkers who demand perfection, these bits are the ultimate solution.

column8: As the world leader of industrial manufacturing saw blades, Freud offers the only fully coated saw blades dedicated to ripping applications in high-production, high-output environments. Featuring the industry’s first ever industrial grade coating, Silver Industrial Cooling Element (Silver I.C.E.) and an extremely tight plate tolerance creates a blade that produces a glue line rip quality in a multi-rip application. Freud’s exclusive Silver I.C.E. coating reduces heat adding longevity to the carbide and blade body for less rework, down time, higher cut quality and more production. In addition, Freud’s modified triple chip grind creates precise, clean cuts in multi-rip blade applications and various manufacturing of moldings, furniture, cabinets, display manufacturing, windows and flooring. Tri-metal brazing allows the tooth to move slightly reducing impact and tooth damage, which proves critical in cutting solid wood with knots common in ripping applications. Freud is industry-leading manufacturer of woodworking tools in the world that produces its own micro-grain carbide for each tool application to maximize life, finish, and productivity.

column8: Freud’s new General Purpose saw blades offer the ultimate value and high durability in production environments. Starting with Freud’s own industry leading TiCo Hi-Density carbide specifically formulated for wood processing delivers up to 3X lower total applied cost over typical production runs of over 5,000 cuts. Utilizing 30% more carbide on the teeth than most other blades allow Freud’s General Purpose blades to outlast and exceed the number of sharpenings, lowering the cost of purchasing new blades, downtime an lost labor hours. Freud’s Alternate Top Bevel (ATB) grind gives a flawless, repeatable cut for less rework and scrap commonly caused by cheaply made, inferior production blades. Built on the legacy and featured technology of Freud’s LSBX Panel sizing blades, these blades can turn a table saw into a high production saw when coupled with Freud Certified Sharpening partners throughout the U.S.
